CustomField.formula:
CASE( DurationofLicenseInMonths__c ,
36,
IF( AND(FirstYearStart__c <= TODAY(), TODAY() <= FirstYearEnd__c), "Triennial 1st Year", IF( AND(SecondYearStart__c <= TODAY(), TODAY() <= SecondYearEnd__c), "Triennial 2nd Year", IF( AND(ThirdYearStart__c <= TODAY(), TODAY() <= ThirdYearEnd__c), "Triennial 3rd Year", NULL))) , 24, IF( AND(FirstYearStart__c <= TODAY(), TODAY() <= FirstYearEnd__c), "Biennial 1st Year", IF( AND(SecondYearStart__c <= TODAY(), TODAY() <= SecondYearEnd__c), "Biennial 2nd Year", IF( AND(ThirdYearStart__c <= TODAY(), TODAY() <= ThirdYearEnd__c), "Biennial 3rd Year", NULL)))
,
18, "Annual 1st Year",
12, "Annual 1st Year",
NULL)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Indicates the current year of the Triennium or Biennium that we are in. The field will display 'Annual 1sr Year' if the License has a duration of 12 months.
CustomField.label: Current License Year
